system.description:
Stout Halfling

Stout halflings are the hardiest of the three halfling subraces and are believed to carry a trace of dwarven blood in their lineage, giving them a more robust constitution and an affinity for underground environments. They are slightly stockier than hairfoot halflings, with darker complexions, broader shoulders, and less pronounced foot-hair. Stouts can often be found dwelling in the foothills and lower reaches of mountain ranges, occasionally sharing territory with dwarven clans. They share the dwarven love of gems and underground places without sharing the dwarven dourness.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Dexterity: +1
  • Constitution: +1
  • Strength: −1

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 60 feet (full dwarven-quality infravision).
  • Missile Attack Bonus: +3 to attack rolls with slings and all thrown weapons.
  • Saving Throw Bonus: +4 to all saving throws vs. magic spells, wand effects, and staves.
  • Stonecunning (Limited): Stout halflings detect grade/slope on 1–3 on a d6 and unsafe stonework on 1–2 on a d6 — less than dwarves but better than hairfoot halflings.
  • Move Silently: Stout halflings move silently in natural terrain and surprise opponents on 1–4 on a d6 outdoors.
  • Poison Resistance: +2 to saving throws vs. poison, reflecting their dwarven heritage.
  • Defensive Bonus: −4 AC vs. ogres, trolls, ogre magi, giants, and titans.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Cleric, Thief; Fighter/Thief multiclass.
system.source: The Complete Book of Gnomes & Halflings
